title: Spherical-DAHA predictions for boundary monopole bubbling of non-minuscule 't Hooft lines in $\mathcal N=4$ SYM
summary: We study non-minuscule boundary 't Hooft lines in four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ $U(N)$ super Yang--Mills theory with the regular Nahm-pole boundary condition. For one-row charges we construct the exact spherical-DAHA operator $\mathbf e_+h_r(Y)\mathbf e_+$, determine its finite shift expansion and discrete Macdonald spectrum, and evaluate the S-dual Neumann Wilson two-line index as a finite-$N$ Macdonald pairing.
